A mobile explorer for real algebraic surfaces.

Adapted from IMAGINARY’s SURFER. The original jsurf ray-tracing core was written by Christian Stussak for the Mathematisches Forschungsinstitut Oberwolfach.

App and jsurf source: Apache License 2.0. Uses the ANTLR runtime (BSD 3-Clause) and Java Vecmath (GPL 2.0 with Classpath Exception).

Enter a polynomial in x, y, and z. The app draws its real zero set inside a sphere.
